nodes.description: Public uint256 price, minimum ether required to mint, initialized to 0.05 ether and mutable via set_price.
Public uint256 maxSupply cap (2100) checked in fallback before minting.
Public uint256 totalSupply counter, incremented in fallback and arbitrarily overwritable by owner via set_total_supply.
Constant address to (0x4135...CfdE) receiving one sixth of the contract balance in withdraw.
Constant address to1 (0xDfd6...E130) receiving the remaining contract balance in withdraw.
Payable fallback that requires msg.value >= price and totalSupply < maxSupply, derives amount from exact msg.value values, updates totalSupply and emits Minted.
Owner-only setter that assigns newprice to the price state variable.
Owner-only setter that assigns val to the totalSupply state variable, allowing supply manipulation.
Owner-only function performing two ether transfers (balance/6.0 to 'to' and full balance to 'to1') using transfer.
Modifier own enforcing msg.sender == hardcoded owner address 0x5e0a...D791; the contract's only access control gate.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller used in the own modifier owner check and in the Minted event.
Local uint256 amount in fallback, derived from msg.value and added to totalSupply.
Parameter newprice of set_price, written into the price state variable.
Parameter val of set_total_supply, written into the totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply += amount state mutation inside fallback; unchecked supply accounting relative to minted ether.
payable(to).transfer(address(this).balance / 6.0); external ether transfer to a constant address with balance-dependent arithmetic.
payable(to1).transfer(address(this).balance); external ether transfer of the remaining balance to a constant address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the hardcoded owner address inside the own modifier, forming the access control check.
msg.sender is passed into the Minted event emitted by the fallback.
own modifier guards set_price, restricting the state write to the hardcoded owner.
own modifier guards set_total_supply, restricting arbitrary supply writes to the hardcoded owner.
own modifier guards withdraw, restricting ether transfers to the hardcoded owner.
Local amount flows into the totalSupply increment operation.
totalSupply += amount writes the totalSupply state variable.
fallback executes the totalSupply increment when amount > 0.
fallback declares and assigns the local amount derived from msg.value.
fallback reads totalSupply for the totalSupply < maxSupply requirement.
fallback reads maxSupply as the minting cap.
fallback reads price in the msg.value >= price requirement.
withdraw triggers an external ether transfer to address to, a state-changing external call.
withdraw triggers a second external ether transfer sending the whole remaining balance to to1.
withdraw uses the constant address to as the transfer recipient.
withdraw uses the constant address to1 as the transfer recipient.
newprice is the input parameter of set_price.
newprice is assigned to the price state variable.
set_price writes the price state variable under owner control.
val is the input parameter of set_total_supply.
val is assigned to the totalSupply state variable.
set_total_supply writes the totalSupply state variable under owner control.
